description: Language-neutral verification conformance vectors. Each vector: a manifest or a COSE envelope, a VerificationContext, and the expected VerificationResult.

envelopes.manifest: v0.1 detached signature over an RFC 8785 pre-image

vectors.description: All bound artifacts match a signed, in-date manifest.
Runtime system_prompt hash differs from the bound hash.
Manifest expires_at is in the past.
Manifest id is present in the revocation store.
Unsigned manifest must never be VALID (fail-closed).
Signed manifest with no trusted keys is UNVERIFIABLE.
Unsupported manifest version is rejected before verifying.
agent_id altered after signing invalidates the signature.
Required HITL with an unexpired approval passes under enforce_hitl.
enforce_hitl with no hitl_record fails closed.
Expired HITL approval is surfaced regardless of enforcement.
Delegation chain with no public keys is UNVERIFIABLE.
Memory baseline past its TTL is reported EXPIRED.
Decision-trace audit chain root matches the runtime root.
RAG corpus with a flagged poisoning scan fails verification.
Bound tool_manifest with no runtime hash is INCOMPLETE in strict mode.
enforce_attestation with no attestation block is ATTESTATION_UNAVAILABLE.
Attestation report hash matching the canonical manifest hash verifies.
Attestation carried forward onto a re-signed manifest binds the previous document.
Signed single-hop delegation chain bound to the manifest issuer verifies.
Post-quantum crypto_profile with an Ed25519 signature is a downgrade.
A trusted key not authorized for the manifest's issuer is rejected.
A key authorized for the subject (agent_id) but not the issuer is rejected.
COSE_Sign1 encoding is pinned byte-for-byte: CBOR tag 18, a four-element array, and a zero-length unprotected header map before any receipt is attached.
A tampered protected header invalidates the signature.
alg present in the unprotected header is rejected, never read.
A vendor-tree typ alias is rejected. The signature over this envelope is valid, so typ is the only defect.
An unprotected header injected after signing does not change the verdict: kid is read from the protected header only.
An untagged COSE structure is rejected rather than inferred.
Trailing bytes after the COSE object are rejected.
A detached (nil) payload is rejected; this profile is inline only.
A trusted key not authorized for the manifest's issuer is rejected. The envelope is byte-identical to AM-VEC-COSE-001 and the signature verifies; only the issuer binding differs.
A payload with a duplicate member name is rejected rather than resolved. The signature over these bytes is valid: the two issuer values are the only defect.
A payload containing the non-JSON literal NaN is rejected, not accepted as a parser extension. The signature over these bytes is valid.
A payload declaring version 0.1 inside a 0.2 COSE envelope returns INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION. The envelope is well formed and the signature over it is valid.
A payload nested past the accepted depth is rejected with a verdict, not a stack exhaustion. The signature over these bytes is valid.
A version 0.2 manifest presented with a v0.1 detached signature block is rejected. The signature is valid and the version is supported; the envelope is the defect.

A payload containing the non-JSON literal Infinity is rejected. Companion to AM-VEC-COSE-011: a verifier that special-cases NaN passes that one and fails this. The signature over these bytes is valid.
